text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are the whirlwind that bites at the 
world! Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worldwide Windy— This duo teams up to 
guide troubled souls day and night... or 
so they say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Much of her activity remains shrouded in 
mystery. I was called to the classroom 
because she had something to discuss, but 
what could it be—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to our emergency special meeting. 
I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Today is an important discussion, I say! 
The title is— "Let's brainstorm a new 
entrance pose!", I say!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! The pose is essential if you 
want the lost sheep to listen to you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whether you can unlock the door to the 
lambs' hearts all depends on your entrance 
pose!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So, I'd like to get your objective opinion 
as well. I'm counting on you♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan wants a cool pose! Everyone 
will be captivated and pay tons of 
attention to me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I vote for a soul-stirring pose. It's 
guaranteed to move hearts and make them 
open right up!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer, which one?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both seem good, but they lack a decisive 
punch. It feels like neither of their 
charms is being fully brought out. I 
decided to give them my honest 
impressions.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmph! Then what should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like it would be best to broaden 
my inspirations. Let's head outside and 
find some ideas!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Could there really be a hint outside? All 
I see are birds flying around, nanoda.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A bird... How about a flapping pose?! Like 
the image of taking flight into the world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...It's a little lame.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a harsh opinion! I love how 
straightforward you are, though!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I want something way more intense! In 
Windy-chan's opinion, something like 
this—"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And then you just... whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy's legs got tangled! She's 
about to hit the ground...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I won't let you~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"What just happened!? My body went 
whoooosh straight up into the air!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I twisted my body and lifted you up 
by using your momentum.

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text: Whirlwind!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That's it! Let's make that spin into our 
pose! After all, we are the whirlwind that 
will sink its teeth into the world!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It fits the image perfectly! And the 
impact is spot on, too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels lonely without any 
"biting" in it...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No problem! Let's stir up a storm and take 
a big bite out of it! Come on, let's give 
it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are the whirlwind that bites at the 
world!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text: Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We did it, I say! I want to go show 
it off to everyone right away!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is the exact pose we were 
looking for!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll stir up a fresh wind and save the 
lost lambs! I'm gonna sink my teeth into 
the common sense of this world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to practice my poses even 
more! I wanna make sure they look super 
cool!
choice_data_list: Let's make your wind movements speedier!

Don't let your guard down on the biting 
pose—make it sharp!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I see, like this!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Spinning round and round~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh...? The world... the world is 
spinning, nanoda~~.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...No, you're wrong! We're the ones 
making the world go round! Which means--"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"We're the center of the world! Sooner or 
later, we're gonna whip up a massive 
whirlwind~~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her poses grow faster and faster with 
every second. At this rate, she really 
might whip up a whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If our posture is sloppy, our words will 
lose all conviction.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time for special training! I'll 
endure and hold my signature pose no 
matter what!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Just a little more patience...! 
Phew...! *pant*, *gasp*, I did it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? Poses knock on the 
heart. If you want to reach them for real, 
you need a real pose!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, lost little lambs! We shall 
guide you! Ohohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as Worldwide Windy is here, the 
lost lambs can rest easy... maybe!
